name: National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9: Hoenn to Paldea)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Expands the playable Pokédex to #1025 with 774 fully animated Pokémon (0 static sprites), Dual Shinies, 72 attacks, 24 Ultimates & 11-language translation.
description: Complete Gen 3 through Gen 9 character and moveset expansion covering Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea (#252-#1025). Adds 419 playable base evolution families, 774 species with 100% animated multi-frame sprites (including upgraded Copperajah and all Gen 7-9 species with zero static sheets), Dual Shinies (official Classic Shiny + custom alternative-palette Shiny), 72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types, 24 custom signature Ultimates, and full 11-language global localization (EN, ES, PT, FR, DE, IT, JA, KO, RU, ZH, ZHT).
highlights: Expands the Pokédex cap from #251 to #1025 across all 7 Gen 3-9 regions (419 playable families, 774 fully animated species — 0 static sprites)
Full 11-language global localization for all 774 Pokémon names, 72 custom moves, 24 Ultimates, roles, and regions
Dual Shinies for all 774 Gen 3-9 Pokémon: official shiny colors as Classic Shiny + custom alternative-palette sprites as Shiny
72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types rendered via PokéBonk native GPU VFX engine
24 custom Ultimates (Rayquaza, Lucario, Garchomp, Greninja, Zacian, Koraidon, Miraidon, Raging Bolt, Terapagos, and more)
